fine_lines.title: future simple vs future continuous
fine_lines.explanation_ar: will + فعل للمستقبل بشكل عام أو قرار: I will call you. will be + فعل ing لحدث سيكون جاريًا في وقت معين في المستقبل: At 10 tomorrow, I will be interviewing her.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Will + verb is for general future facts or decisions: I will call you. Will be + -ing is for an action in progress at a certain future time: At 10 tomorrow, I will be interviewing her.

examples.sentence: Anna will interview a guest next week.
This time tomorrow, Anna will be interviewing her guest.

fine_lines.title: will be -ing vs going to be -ing
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الصيغتان للمستقبل المستمر وبنفس المعنى تقريبًا: I'll be performing in Texas = I'm going to be performing in Texas.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both make the future continuous with almost the same meaning: I'll be teaching = I'm going to be teaching.

examples.sentence: In June, I'll be traveling across Texas.
In July, I'm going to be teaching at a camp.

grammar.title: Future continuous
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم المستقبل المستمر لحدث سيكون جاريًا (في منتصف حدوثه) في وقت معين أو حوله في المستقبل. له صيغتان: 1) will be + فعل ing: Tomorrow, you'll be interviewing Emma G. 2) am/is/are + going to be + فعل ing: In July, I'm going to be teaching at a camp. نذكر غالبًا الوقت: tomorrow, in June, this time next week. النفي: won't be + ing.
grammar.explanation_en: Use the future continuous for an action that will be in progress at or around a time in the future. Two forms: 1) will be + -ing: Tomorrow, you'll be interviewing Emma G. 2) am/is/are + going to be + -ing: In July, I'm going to be teaching at a camp. We often give the time: tomorrow, in June, this time next week. Negative: won't be + -ing.
examples: Tomorrow, you'll be interviewing musician Emma G.
Today, musician Emma G will be joining us here!
In early June, I'll be performing at several venues across Austin, Texas.
I'll be visiting my sister then.
